posts.title: Can Claude fix itself? From no to maybe
posts.description: An Anthropic engineer's answer shifted from no to maybe in six months. Three incidents show what Claude can investigate, fix, and still get wrong.

posts.title: AI handles incidents, engineers lose touch with their systems
posts.description: AI-assisted incident response can lower MTTR while leaving engineers less prepared for the complex incidents automation cannot solve.

posts.title: AI Writes the Code, But Humans Can't Review It All. Now What?
posts.description: AI can generate code faster than humans can review it. Engineering teams must redesign review, reversibility, and accountability.
